name: Beetroot, Walnut & Poppy Seed Chicken Salad
description: The dressing is really what steals the show - tangy, bright and perfectly complements the caraway chicken. This is exactly the right dish to eat to nourish yourself after a hard day at work.
keywords: Beetroot, Walnut & Poppy Seed Chicken Salad
instructions: Coarsely crush the caraway seeds. Butterfly the chicken breasts, then season on both sides with salt, pepper and the crushed caraway seeds.
Pick the dill fronds and thinly slice any soft stems. Discard any tough stems from the kale, then massage the leaves with a drizzle of olive oil until softened. Chop the beetroot into 2-3cm chunks.
Into a large bowl, add the yoghurt, mustard, creamed horseradish and poppy seeds. Grate in the zest of the lemon and squeeze in the juice, then season with salt.
Gently crush the walnuts. Place a frying pan over a medium heat and, once hot, add the walnuts and toast for 3-4 mins, until golden. Transfer into the dressing.
Into the now empty frying pan, add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken breasts and cook for 10-15 mins, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Share the chicken onto plates. Toss the dill, kale and beetroot into the dressing. Top the chicken with the salad and finish with a crack of black pepper.
